data.one_liner: A library for building statically-typed React UI components using Dart.
data.what_it_does: OverReact is a library built atop the Dart react package that helps developers create statically-typed React UI components and applications using Dart. It provides core abstractions like UiFactory, UiProps, UiState, and UiComponent2 to mirror the React JS component model.
use_when: You are building web applications in Dart that interop with React JS.
You prefer writing React UI components with static typing and builder patterns in Dart.
avoid_when: You are building native Flutter mobile or desktop applications.
You do not want to use code generation and build_runner for your web components.
strengths: Statically-typed props and state maps for React components in Dart.
Provides migration paths from older boilerplate and component architectures.
Includes support for Redux integration and an analyzer plugin for lints.
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation setup.
Tied to the React ecosystem and web targets rather than native Flutter widgets.
data.setup_notes: Add over_react as a dependency, enable the analyzer plugin, include native JavaScript react and react_dom libraries in your index.html, run tests and code generation using build_runner.
